What's a spicule?

What it isTiny CICA spicules in a watery serum. Smaller than a grain of sand.
Vs. pore stripsThose dots are dead skin and oil stuck in the pore opening. A strip rips them out and they fill right back up.The spicules peel away the dead skin around the pore as you tap, so there's nothing to pull.
3

How to shoot it

These are talking points, not a script. Say it your way.
1Open on the habit
  • Open on footage of the bad habit. ⭐ A pore strip ripping off, or tweezers pulling gunk out of a nose.
  • The more clips you show, the stronger the hook.
"if your nose looks like a strawberry, pulling them out won't fix it"
2Pat on the spicule serum
  • First say why that habit is wrong. Ripping blackheads out of a strawberry nose is way too harsh on your skin and your pores. ⭐
  • Pat the spicule serum over your nose and chin.
  • Then say what the serum does. The Korean spicule serum gently peels away the dead skin around your pores, so your nose looks smoother.
"ripping them out is way too harsh on your skin""I've been using this instead of the strips"Tell us why you switched
3Show the After
  • Same light, same angle as your first shot.
  • Run a finger over your nose and chin.
  • Mention "save this before you buy another pack of strips"
"save this before you buy another pack of strips"
